So the earlier mechanistic intervention and this one agree: the recurrence and the retrieval are in

the_finding_that_replaces_the_hypothesis: CAPABILITY COMPETITION. Across every configuration tested, state-tracking extrapolation and
retrieval extrapolation trade against one another, and the trade is not favourable: the LSTM alone
scores (mod_sum 0.992, needle 0.283) while the best hybrid scores (0.291, 0.841). The hybrid buys
0.56 of retrieval for 0.70 of state tracking.
This is a negative result about architecture composition, and it is not resolved by any of: three
attention normalisers, three dropout rates, or test-time branch ablation.
